brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished agricultural installations in the village of Beit Dajan, situated east of Nablus in the northern West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted farming structures used by local Palestinians for crop production and livestock management.

The demolitions mark the latest in a series of actions by Israeli forces affecting Palestinian agricultural infrastructure across occupied territory. Residents of Beit Dajan have faced repeated incidents of property destruction targeting their farming operations and rural livelihoods in recent years.
title: Israeli forces demolish agricultural facilities in Beit Dajan east of Nablus
